Bar Council, UGC Advise Students to Verify College Credentials

The Bar Council of India has issued an advisory, following a Supreme Court order, asking law students to verify the approval and affiliation of their colleges before seeking admission. The advisory also warns institutions against making misleading claims regarding their approval status, sanctioned student intake, and eligibility to impart professional legal education. Similarly, the University Grants Commission (UGC) has advised parents and students to not rely solely on advertisements and to check the credentials of universities before seeking admission.
